nodes.label: Tests for the /apps router and HTMX limit/block/allow endpoints.
GET /apps with a valid session returns 200 and app titles.
POST /apps/{package}/limit calls set_app_limit with int minutes and returns 200.
POST /apps/{package}/block calls block_app and returns 200 with partial HTML.
A heading section for each child appears when two supervised children exist.
With one child the response contains no child switcher navigation.
Apps page kid switcher renders colored avatar initial when multiple children exi
A 'limited' app row includes the auto-block checkbox, checked when opted in.
A 'blocked' app row does not include the auto-block checkbox.
POST /apps/{package}/auto-block with enabled=true creates a row and returns 200.
POST with enabled omitted (unchecked) clears the opt-in flag on an existing row.
POST /apps/{package}/bonus on an auto-blocked app calls set_app_limit and clears
A second bonus grant on the same day adds to bonus_mins instead of resetting it.
A bonus grant on a new day starts fresh instead of adding to yesterday's leftove
POST /apps/{package}/bonus with minutes=-15 returns 400, not applied.
POST /apps/{package}/bonus with minutes=45 (not a 15/30/60 preset) returns 400.
POST /apps/{package}/bonus for a package not found on the child returns 404.
Bonus buttons appear on an auto-blocked row and not otherwise.
